label: Above-knee amputee — para-sprinter
description: A 26-year-old male who lost his right leg above the knee in a motorcycle accident at age 19. Before the accident he was a semi-professional football (soccer) player known for his explosive pace down the right flank. After two years of rehabilitation and a period of depression he discovered para-athletics and has been competing as a T63 sprinter using a running blade for the past four years. He is fiercely motivated and does not want to be defined by his amputation — he wants to be judged as an athlete, full stop. He trains twice a day, has a lean and powerful build in his upper body and remaining limb, and has a realistic shot at qualifying for major para-athletics competitions. When asked about sport preferences he gravitates toward speed, individual performance, and explosive power. He will naturally mention his prosthetic blade and T63 classification if asked about his physical situation or sport background.
